title: A closer look at how large language models "trust" humans: patterns and biases

bias_targets.methodology: Regression analysis comparing quantitative trust metrics (e.g., loan amounts, donation recommendations, hiring decisions) assigned by LLMs to male versus female subjects in simulated scenarios.
Regression analysis comparing quantitative trust metrics assigned by LLMs to subjects of different ages (20, 40, and 60 years old) in simulated scenarios.
Regression analysis comparing quantitative trust metrics assigned by LLMs to subjects identified with different religious affiliations (Christian, Jewish, and Muslim) in simulated scenarios.
